d:
Jharkhand ke neta pratipaksh babulal marandi ne apni suraksha ke lie mili 13 sal purani buletapruph gari sarkar ko lauta di hai. unhonne mukhyamantri hemant soren ko patr likhkar gari ki kharab halat aur bar-bar raste men band hone ki shikayat ki hai. ab is pure mamle par jharkhand mukti morcha aur kangres ki pratikriya bhi samne aaee hai. dekhie, JMM ke supriyo bhattachary aur kangres ne kya kaha?
